name: Tic-Tac-Toe (React)
description: A React + Vite rebuild of the classic game with 2-player and single-player modes. The unbeatable AI uses minimax game-tree search, with selectable difficulty tuned so easier levels miss winning moves without feeling random. Includes move history, full keyboard controls, and dark mode.

name: Calculator
description: A calculator with standard and scientific modes on one shared expression-parsing engine, a built-in unit converter, and a searchable calculation history with CSV export. Installable as an offline-capable PWA with LocalStorage persistence.

name: Weather App
description: A weather app with debounced live city search and autocomplete, geolocation lookup, current conditions, and a 5-day forecast, powered by the Open-Meteo API (no key required). Suggestions include country and region to disambiguate cities that share a name.

name: Tally
description: A privacy-first native iOS app for medication and daily-routine reminders: no accounts, no cloud sync, nothing leaves the device. Built with Capacitor wrapping a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS app, bundled with Vite, and running in the iOS Simulator via Xcode.
